description:
Candace Owens says Charlie Kirk appeared to her in a dream—revealing that he’d been betrayed. But could that really happen? In this video, we explore what the Bible actually says about communicating with the dead, dreams that seem supernatural, and how deception can disguise itself as light.
Stay with us as we break down the truth behind Candace’s dream, the spiritual dangers hidden in modern “visitations,” and what happens when you die.
